topics.title: COP31 opens with a focus on visible progress
topics.summary: Delegates from more than 190 countries are gathering in Turkey for COP31, where hosts say climate progress needs to be tangible in everyday life as talks begin.
topics.discussionPrompt: When leaders promise progress people can actually notice, what would count most where you live: cleaner air, cheaper power, better transit, or something else?

topics.title: EU questions TikTok's protections for young users
topics.summary: The European Union has charged TikTok with failing to protect users' mental health, putting fresh attention on how platforms design feeds and safety tools.
topics.discussionPrompt: What is one app setting you wish more people knew about? Would it genuinely make online time calmer, or would the feed just find another way to pull us in?

topics.title: Tesla shifts its Cybertruck plans
topics.summary: Tesla is reportedly preparing to wind down Cybertruck production as Elon Musk puts greater emphasis on robotics and artificial intelligence.
topics.discussionPrompt: Would you rather see companies keep polishing familiar products or gamble on entirely new ideas? Which one usually makes life better for regular people?

topics.title: Salary ranges could become a standard job-ad detail
topics.summary: A proposal in Greater Manchester would require employers to include salary ranges in job advertisements, aiming to make pay expectations clearer from the start.
topics.discussionPrompt: Would seeing the salary first change how you job-search, or would you still care more about the team, flexibility, and work itself?

topics.title: London commuters prepare for Tube strikes
topics.summary: Tube driver strikes are expected to disrupt travel and shopping in London in the run-up to Christmas, prompting commuters to rethink their usual routes.
topics.discussionPrompt: When your normal commute gets scrambled, are you a route-planning wizard, a last-minute improviser, or someone who simply stays home?

topics.title: UK dairy farmers face new price pressure
topics.summary: A major milk processor's planned price cuts are adding pressure for dairy farmers, highlighting how quickly retail and farm economics can pull in different directions.
topics.discussionPrompt: When you buy everyday food, do you ever think about what the producer gets paid? What would make shopping feel more connected to the people who make it?

topics.title: A new museum puts space-age design on show
topics.summary: Powerhouse Parramatta in Sydney has opened with dramatic architecture and collections that include a sculpture inspired by the Voyager 1 space probe.
topics.discussionPrompt: If your town opened a huge new museum, what odd or ordinary object absolutely deserves a place in its first exhibition?

topics.title: Lightning gets a closer look in a warming world
topics.summary: A new science feature explores how researchers study lightning and how changing weather patterns may shape our experience of one of nature's most dramatic displays.
topics.discussionPrompt: Do thunderstorms feel exciting, cozy, or mostly inconvenient to you? What is the best place to watch one safely?

topics.title: Floods bring welcome water to Lake Powell
topics.summary: Recent floods in the US Southwest have lifted Lake Powell by about 20 feet, offering rare relief for reservoirs after long-running drought concerns.
topics.discussionPrompt: A sudden burst of rain can feel like a rescue and a headache at once. What is the weather change that most transforms your mood?

topics.title: College football's top ranking may be up for grabs
topics.summary: Notre Dame and Georgia are positioned to challenge Miami for the top spot in the AP Top 25, adding extra suspense to the college-football conversation.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a favorite finally looks vulnerable, do you cheer for the underdog, defend the champion, or just enjoy the chaos?
